author: NASASpaceflight
description:
The California Science Center just unveiled stunning first looks at Endeavour stacked vertically in full launch position - the world’s only complete Space Shuttle System on public display!

This epic reveal is coming to the new Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center on November 13, 2026.
